ItemId.description: The policy's 26-character id. When it matches a stored policy, that policy is updated.

Amount.description: The fixed amount of each fee, in the invoice's currency.

Percent.description: The percent of what is still due each fee charges.

GraceDays.description: How many days after the due date pass before the first fee.

RepeatEveryDays.description: How many days after a fee the next one is charged; 0 charges one fee.

MaxFees.description: The most fees charged on one invoice.

CapAmount.description: The most charged in fees on one invoice.

MinimumBalance.description: The least that must still be due for a fee.

Taxable.description: Whether the fee is taxed like a sale.

SendDebitNote.description: Whether each debit note is e-mailed once issued.

Policies.description: The late-fee policies to create or update.
